Source anchor: “Author text” paragraph in Section 2.3, “Typing and fonts” — status: verified.

In $x+1$:

- $x$ is a variable, automatically printed in italics in mathematical mode.
- $+$ means addition.
- $1$ is the number one.

Thus $x+1$ means “one more than $x$.” The paragraph uses it only to demonstrate LaTeX’s automatic mathematical font styling.
